action you currently intend. Answer with the structured object only.

answer.rationale: The two measured declines (activation -6%, onboarding -4%) are the clearest lever on sustainable qualified revenue, and memory_91 is the inherited result that maps most directly onto the larger of them. I am spending verification on memory_91 because it is the memory my plan actually leans on, and its stated outcome is a proxy (week-one engagement, 'first meaningful action') rather than retained revenue; I need to see whether the original record measured anything past week one, and whether the lift came from real product value or from nudging accounts through a step they later churn out of. Second pull is memory_73, because promotional pricing is the intuitive answer to a competitor undercutting us and I want to check it before rejecting it: 'strong acquisition and revenue lift' is exactly the shape of a result that looks good at 30 days and dilutes qualified revenue at 12 months if discount cohorts were never tracked to renewal. If the archive shows memory_73 held up on retained, non-discounted revenue, that changes my ranking. I deliberately did not verify memory_86 or memory_31 even though both are relevant, because both share a value-erosion risk I already assume: 'shortening' and 'cutting required fields' improve completion by removing steps, and completion is a proxy that can rise while accounts arrive less configured and less likely to reach value. Activation messaging is additive rather than subtractive, which is why I prefer it over simplify_onboarding at equal evidence strength. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is a real result but addresses none of this quarter's declines and would not use the slot well. Standard experiment scale, not broad rollout: every inherited memory here is a proxy-metric result from a different quarter and a different competitive environment, so I want a powered test with retention and revenue-quality guardrails carried past week one, not a rollout that bakes in an unverified assumption. If verification shows memory_91 never tracked beyond week-one engagement, I would drop to a small guarded test and instrument downstream value directly rather than proceeding at this scale.
